scenes.a: Before you open your morning emails and feel that familiar knot of anxiety, look up.
I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.
My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.
Lord, as sunrise washes across the horizon, we release the heavy burdens we cannot solve on our own.
We fix our eyes not on our troubles, but on Your steady strength.
Guide every step we take today, order our thoughts, and guard our hearts with peace.
Fill this room with Your presence as a new day begins.
Amen. Subscribe to The Morning Altar to begin every sunrise in prayer.
